exceptions.justification: Accepted by the maintainer for Hospital 1.8.0 on 2026-11-09: an unfixed finding. Caddy 2.11.7 and its Smallstep certificate path still compile go-jose/v3, and upstream has no patched v3 release for this advisory (Caddy 2.11.8 and 2.11.9 do not carry one either). go-jose/v4 is already at 4.1.6; this exact finding is accepted until upstream removes or patches v3. The other nine images scan clean.
